name: Ceylon Compass Holidays

cards.style: small, colourful, white background with one accent colour per card

motion.rule: No scroll-triggered or parallax animation. Transitions under 200 ms.

tone_of_voice: Warm but not gushing; no exclamation marks in prices or policies.
Never promise what the content or rates do not support.
Say 'we' for the company and 'I' for Mira.
do_not: Use photos or brand names you do not have rights to
Use more than one accent colour on a card
